title: UN Commission finding on the Hind Rajab family and ambulance attack
summary: The Commission investigated the killing of a family in a vehicle and two paramedics in a dispatched ambulance on 29 January 2024.
claim: The Commission concluded on reasonable grounds that the Israeli 162 Division was operating in the area and was responsible for killing the family of seven, including five children, and shelling the ambulance, killing two paramedics.
legal_characterization: UN Commission finding that the actions constituted war crimes of wilful killing and an attack against civilian objects; not a judicial judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 95 and the underlying factual discussion in paragraph 11 of A/79/232. Attribution and the reasonable-grounds standard are preserved; this is not presented as an individual criminal conviction.
